caption: The drawing features a large, rectangular, white stone tomb positioned in the center foreground. The tomb has a flat lid with faint red marks or writing on its top surface. Behind the tomb, there is a large green, mound-like hill that serves as the background, with the remainder of the background being brown and textured, perhaps to indicate rock or earth. On the left side of the tomb, three human figures with light skin and dark brown hair are shown huddled together, draped in reddish-brown garments. On the right side, three more human figures are present; two are partially reclining and one is sitting up. These figures also have light skin, with brown or dark hair, and are dressed in similar hues of brown and reddish-brown. Some of the figures on the right appear to be holding or wearing gray metallic armor and weapons, depicted with lines and shaded areas. The overall color palette consists of earth tones, with greens, browns, and whites dominating the composition.
title: Station of the Cross No. 14: "Jesus is Laid in His Tomb"
